Launches an interactive terminal user interface (TUI) or outputs semantic
machine-readable

projections for inspecting and navigating kernel object instances.



Provides modular display modules for lineage, storage profile, CAS digests, and
metadata.

Includes an interactive Policy Rule Studio for authoring, dry-running, and
testing validation DSLs.

  Launch interactive object inspector
  zqk object inspect
  Inspect backlog items with quick filters
  zqk object inspect backlog_item
  Inspect specific requirement details
  zqk object inspect requirement REQ-012
  Launch Policy Rule Studio
  zqk object inspect policy --policy-studio
  Semantic agent-friendly JSON projection
  zqk object inspect backlog_item --format json

Usage:
  zqk object inspect [flags]

Aliases:
  inspect, ins

Flags:
      --fields stringArray   Keys to include per object (repeat or comma-separated); omit for full rows
      --filter stringArray   Initial filter expressions (field=value, field!=value)
  -f, --format string        Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link, raw, md, html) (default "table")
      --id string            Specific object identifier to inspect immediately in modal detail
      --kind string          Initial object kind to inspect (e.g. backlog_item, requirement, test_case, policy)
  -o, --output string        Write output to file
      --policy-studio        Launch directly into the interactive Policy Rule Studio
      --rule-expr string     Evaluate a custom DSL predicate expression across repository objects in real time
      --sort-asc             Sort ascending (default is descending/newest first)
      --sort-by string       Initial sort field (default "updated_at") (default "updated_at")
      --suggest-dsl string   Get autocomplete suggestions for a DSL input prefix
      --timeout duration     Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose              Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
      --internal         Elevated access mode for built-in and internal kinds (requires Enterprise license or zqk-admin)
